messages:
nora: Quick flag — Emilio R. (emp 88221) got a one-time international retention bonus paid 2025-09-15. It looks like the bonus was taxed under US payroll and also taxed by the NL payroll provider. Employee is NL tax resident; we should have grossed up or coordinated withholding to avoid double tax. Need remediation and to know if W-2c/1099 correction needed.

sam-payroll: Can you confirm payment channel and whether the amount was included in ADP as US-source wages?

nora: Payment channel: company wire via global payroll (Run ID GP-2025-09-78). HRIS export shows the bonus entered into US payroll as code BONUS_US. NL vendor also shows TAX_WITHHELD on their run. Looks like duplicate entry for the same gross.

eli-hr: Emilio moved to Amsterdam 2025-03-01 and completed paperwork. We flagged his tax location as NL, but the bonus capture was manual by the hiring manager and went to US payroll by mistake.

tara-finance: Materiality: gross bonus €8,500 (~$9,100). NL withholding ~€1,530, US withholding taken ~$1,368. Employee net impacted. We need to coordinate with NL vendor for refund or credit, and consider W-2 reporting for US side: if we remove the US-taxed amount from US wages, that could change taxable wages and withholdings — may require a W-2c.

sam-payroll: I'll open vendor ticket with GlobalPay NL and our ADP rep. Also need employee authorization if we do net reimburse/refund to their NL bank.

payroll-bot: Ticket created: GP-2421012345. Off-cycle prelim logged: OR-2421012345. Status: awaiting vendor response.

sam-payroll: Short-term fix: suspend any year-end reconciliations for Emilio until vendor confirms duplicate tax recovery method. Long-term: we need a control to prevent manual bonus entries into the wrong payroll when country != payroll country.

nora: Agreed — I'll add a step to the relocation checklist. For now Emilio asked for an explanation and prefers refund to NL payroll to avoid US tax implications.

tara-finance: I'll draft the authorization form template for Emilio to sign so we can instruct NL vendor to refund withholding and update their year-end statements. If ADP indicates US wages must be adjusted, we'll get the W-2c signed before filing.

sam-payroll: ADP says if US taxable wages included the bonus, a W-2c will likely be required to adjust federal/state wages. Notify Emilio and collect consent for W-2c if needed.

eli-hr: I'll message Emilio, collect written consent, and attach to the vendor ticket.

nora: Thanks. Keeping this thread as source of truth. Please tag when vendor responds.

payroll-bot: GP-2421012345 updated by tara-finance at 2025-12-02T14:20Z: NL vendor confirmed refund path. Next steps: process NL refund and prepare US wage adjustment pending employee consent.
